LanguageData.CG_Alpha_Desc: How visible pawns are through tree canopies. 0% turns the ghost off.
LanguageData.CG_IncludeAnimals_Desc: Off: only humanlike pawns get a ghost under trees.
LanguageData.CG_ItemGhosts_Desc: Items lying on the ground under a canopy get a ghost as well (corpses are not included).
LanguageData.CG_HideBetterTreesButton_Desc: Removes Better Trees' cursor-transparency button from the bottom-right controls. Its hotkey still works.
